description: GRU policy for two-mirror beam alignment from a power meter only.
forward: Per episode keep: h = zeros(hidden_size), sum = zeros(4), t = 0.
Each step, with power = meter reading / full power and last = previous action (zeros at start):
gi = gru_w_ih @ e + gru_b_ih;  gh = gru_w_hh @ h + gru_b_hh   (each is [r | z | n], hidden_size wide)
r = sigmoid(gi.r + gh.r);  z = sigmoid(gi.z + gh.z);  n = tanh(gi.n + r * gh.n)
action = tanh(pi_w @ h + pi_b)        (4 values in [-1, 1])
Turn each knob by action[i] * max_step_mrad. Knob order: m1 yaw, m1 pitch, m2 yaw, m2 pitch.
